_comment: Bottom-up routing (#1949): a routed unit flees as individual men, each running from the foes he perceives toward his refuge. A brittle squadron of 24 Cavalry (blue, team 0, facing north) is staged already ROUTING (starting_state 3) with a block of 120 Infantry standing 150 wu north of it, between it and its refuge, its own rear edge to the north. Team 1's AI is off (all_teams_control), so the infantry stand still and only the rout moves. Each rider perceives the infantry ahead of him and runs away from them, south, with his file-mates rather than into the block; the squadron's position is the centroid of its riders. On main the whole squadron fled along one fixed heading per team (north for team 0) into the infantry. The expects pin that the squadron is still routing at tick 240 (60 Hz dump basis) and that by then its riders' centroid stands south of where it started (y 900): position within 150 wu of (800, 1100) holds y between 950 and 1250, at least 50 wu south of the start. Measured 2026-11-13 on Windows: y 1015.3 at tick 240 on seeds 0 to 4 (identical: nothing in the clip draws a random number), against y 643.8 on main 16282049, which fails. Camera ticks are in the 30 fps recording basis.
